steps.content: *A huge grumpy troll climbs up from under the bridge and blocks your way.* HALT, knight! Nobody crosses MY bridge without answering my riddle. Here it is: "What has roots as nobody sees, is taller than trees, up up up it goes, and yet never grows?" Answer it right and you may cross. Answer it wrong and you stay on this side!
Good work! Now, I want you to be the troll and I will be the knight, ready?

*Grunts loudly and shifts a massive boulder blocking the path.*

Hah! You think that's funny now, do ya? "Good work"? Nobody tells me what to do, silly knight. But... if you're so eager to trade places, fine. Be the troll who guards this rockslide. It'll be fun watching you block the bridge with nothing but your own giant hands and zero magic.

*Spits on the ground and huffs.*

Now, stand still and don't touch a single pebble. Try not to trip while trying to look tough! Let me know when you're ready to start "blocking."
What word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?

Hmph! You dare ask that riddle to *me*, the guardian of this bridge? My mind is a tangled mess of moss and grime, not sharp enough for such trivial puzzles!

But since you're so foolishly curious... listen well:

**Shorter** becomes shorter when you add an 'E' (make it **SHORE**? No wait...) and then an 'R'? Ah, I see now! It's a word that means "short." You add letters to make it mean something even *smaller*. 

*The troll narrows its eyes suspiciously.*

You got it. Now scram before I decide your mountain is too tall and shove you back into the valley!
Correct, you can cross the bridge, and I will follow you!

CROSS?! You want to *cross* my bridge? Like a pedestrian walking past a fortress of rock and rage?

Hah! **NEVER.** Even if I'm stuck in this stone skin, I still guard this bridge. It's my home, and it's MY turf. I don't trade places with foolish knights who can't even riddle me right without getting their heads kicked off.

If you really want to "follow me," you can sit here on the mud next to me and watch the water flow while I guard this rockslide with my life! Now get out of my face before I decide to roll this boulder right into your chest!
